# Pill

A status pill: a subtle background with text in the same hue, optionally with a status dot. Use it for all
statuses and markers in the application instead of mixing in Tag.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Statuses such as In progress / Archived, markers such as "Owner" or "Connected", tags

## Import

```ts
import { Pill } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Statuses get a dot; the same status uses the same tone throughout the application.

```tsx
import { Inline, Pill } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={2}>
      <Pill tone="success" dot>
        In progress
      </Pill>
      <Pill dot>Disabled</Pill>
      <Pill tone="warning" dot>
        Pending
      </Pill>
      <Pill tone="danger" dot>
        Connection failed
      </Pill>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Marks and tags

Pills without a dot are used for marks such as "Owner" and for content tags.

```tsx
import { Inline, Pill } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Tags() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={2}>
      <Pill tone="accent">Owner</Pill>
      <Pill icon="pin">Pinned</Pill>
      <Pill>Design</Pill>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'info'` | Tone: `neutral`, `accent`, or the semantic states `success` / `warning` / `danger` / `info`. | `'neutral'` | No |
| `dot` | `boolean` | Leading dot (indicates a status). | — | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Leading icon. | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Text of the pill. | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Tooltip shown on hover. | — | No |
| `data-testid` | `string` | Locator for tests. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.
